meta.one_liner: The 200-year-old adage, tested: hold SPY November through April, sit out May through October.
meta.explainer_md: 'Sell in May and go away' claims most of the market's gains happen in the winter months. This strategy holds SPY from November through April and moves to cash from May through October — nothing else. It's one of the most famous seasonal claims in finance, and now you can see exactly what following it would have done, versus just staying invested all year. Ask the chat: 'what if I stayed long all year instead?'

spec.name: Sell in May
spec.description: Long SPY November-April only; cash May-October.
